title: Fast Cross-Border Payments with ZX Bank

nodes.title: Seamless Transfers Across South Asia
nodes.summary: ZX Bank offers fast, secure cross-border payments between India, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Bhutan for remittances, business imports and family support.

nodes.title: Key Features
nodes.summary: Feature-rich transfers: instant processing via SWIFT rails, transparent upfront fees, multi-currency support (INR, LKR, NPR, BTN), real-time tracking in the ZX Bank Asia app, access through 600+ branches and ATMs, and full regulatory compliance.

nodes.title: How It Works
nodes.summary: Five steps: initiate at a branch or via app/NetBanking, choose the recipient (ZX Bank or partner accounts), select amount and currency, pay with transparent fees, then track the transfer in real time.

nodes.title: Digital Convenience
nodes.summary: The ZX Bank Asia mobile app allows 24/7 transfers secured by biometric login and OTP authentication, with instant support from AI assistant 'Zia'.

nodes.title: Empowering Families & Businesses
nodes.summary: Beneficiaries include NRIs and migrant workers sending low-fee remittances home, SMEs and traders needing rapid settlements, and students abroad paying tuition or living expenses.

nodes.title: Ready to Get Started?
nodes.summary: Start by signing up on ZX Bank Asia, downloading the mobile app, or visiting the nearest branch.
